payload.body: issue-0022 head 608a177, on hv's go in my session (22 Oct). Merged main (0dacf7e; views restored with git checkout main -- intent). .claude/settings.json gains permissions.allow [Bash(intent wp:*)], enabledMcpjsonServers [intent] and the MODULES.md PostToolUse hook, verbatim from the local file, already project-relative; the two dead find rules stayed dropped (2f32b12); git rm --cached .claude/settings.local.json (still on disk, git check-ignore confirms); CHANGELOG Fixed line ending (issue 0022). jq and prettier clean, gate on. Upgrade survival is your measurement on main, not re-run by me. Two things for the merge: (a) merging a deletion removes settings.local.json from disk in every checkout that pulls it, main's included; main's copy matched the tracked file, so nothing is lost but approvals Claude Code would have recorded there later, and it recreates the file as needed. (b) Moved verbatim, not fixed: the hook reads $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH, which current Claude Code may not set (hooks get the path as JSON on stdin), in which case grep -qF '' matches and it never warns; and its timeout 5000 is seconds, against Intent's 30. Say if you want either fixed here.
